description: Main source code for sensor hub application using Zephyr RTOS, configuring and reading data from STMicroelectronics sensors (IIS2DLPC and ISM330DHCX), with trigger handlers and sensor data display.

methods.name: iis2dlpc_trigger_handler
methods.description: Trigger handler for IIS2DLPC sensor, fetches accelerometer sample and increments trigger count.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_acc_trig_handler
methods.description: Trigger handler for ISM330DHCX accelerometer, fetches accelerometer data and increments trigger count.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_gyr_trig_handler
methods.description: Trigger handler for ISM330DHCX gyroscope, fetches gyro data and increments trigger count.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_temp_trig_handler
methods.description: Trigger handler for ISM330DHCX temperature, fetches temperature data and increments trigger count.

methods.name: iis2dlpc_config
methods.description: Configures IIS2DLPC sensor sampling frequency and full scale, sets trigger if enabled.

methods.name: ism330dhcx_config
methods.description: Configures ISM330DHCX sensor sampling frequencies, full scales, and triggers for accelerometer, gyroscope, temperature, and external magn sensor.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing sensors, configuring them, and continuously fetching and displaying sensor data with trigger counts.
